blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu and the rest of the Visayas will experience partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms on Tuesday, October 20, as localized thunderstorms and the trough of Super Typhoon Champi affect parts of the region.
